description: The key terms a recruiter should spot in a six-second skim of one of the user's CVs; they belong in the top third of page 1. Free, no AI. Use when the user asks whether their CV makes a strong first impression; get_takemeup_cv_preview shows what's actually up there.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: check_takemeup_six_second
title: Six-second skim test (free)
